method: Each identity received broad dated financing searches, issuer/company-history review and investor or transaction-party checks. Existing database events were reconciled against original announcements. Cumulative totals, consortium budgets, fundraising intentions and subsidiary expansion spending were not converted into recipient financing events.

dispositions.finding: The 2018 USD10m seed and 2025 USD130m Series B are source-supported. Company releases in 2020 state USD25m cumulative venture backing, leaving an unsplit historical USD15m difference; no fabricated intermediate round was added.

The seed, 2025 convertibles/shareholder loans, Commerzbank facility and 2026 Helsing disclosure remain supported. The company's statement of more than EUR200m previously raised equity is cumulative and does not disclose the missing round-by-round history, so it remains a hold.

SEC filings reconcile the SAFE financing, 2025 Series A closings and conversion, January 2026 extension and March 2026 IPO. The later Ratel acquisition is an outbound transaction and was not mislabelled as financing received by Swarmer.
HTGF confirms the EUR10.25m seed led by IQ Capital and identifies General Catalyst and HCVC as the pre-seed leads. No additional attributable round was established.

Transaction counsel confirms OTB Ventures and Visionaries Club co-led an earlier seed round. The official EUR30m Series A brings total funding to EUR46m, but the exact seed amount, date and full earlier composition remain undisclosed.

The company reports EUR40m total funding after its EUR30m Series A. Public sources do not provide a primary, granular account of the earlier EUR10m, and a secondary EUR4m seed claim was not promoted into a verified event.
The EUR4m 2024 package remains correctly split into EUR2.4m equity and EUR1.6m grants. No later or earlier attributable financing event was established.

The 2012 first round from SHIFT Invest/Mainport Innovation Fund and INKEF was reconciled. Robin Radar's 11 October 2024 announcement supports Parcom's acquisition; value and stake percentage remain undisclosed and the event is labelled secondary.

The issuer's first funding round remains amount-undisclosed. Direct investor announcements now support links to 1991 Ventures and Double Tap Investments; unnamed angels and funds remain unnamed. The separate Axon investment is preserved.

The U.S.–Ukraine Reconstruction Investment Fund board approved an equity investment on 25 March 2026. Neither the official DFC release nor issuer material discloses an amount or closing beyond approval, so the existing event is unchanged.

USD3.5m refers to Skyeton's spending to launch Slovak production, not an external round received by the parent. A USD15m raise was still being sought. Secondary claims of a June 2025 placement lack issuer or investor confirmation and remain a hold.
The CZK15m 2022 convertible financing from Y Soft Ventures is supported. Accelerator cohort support was not treated as a drawn company grant without a company-specific award amount.
The EUR2.4m 2025 pre-seed and amount-undisclosed July 2026 MITS strategic investment are fully supported by issuer and investor sources; no other public round was established.

Two additional company-specific grants were verified: EUR500,000 from Enterprise Estonia/ERDF for Marduk Shark and EUR196,000 from the Estonian Ministry of Defence in 2025. The existing 2024 grant was corrected from undisclosed to EUR93,875 using an expected-old-value transaction and exact rollback.

The existing EUR136,952.72 SEKMO grant is company-specific. Secondary CORDIS-derived beneficiary tables list further EDF allocations, but project-level official records were not fully reconciled in this pass, so no aggregate amount was converted into a round.
The EUR7m January 2026 strategic round led by Vsquared with Day One Capital and Assembly Ventures remains the only attributable public financing event found.

Delair's own press kit establishes EUR3m seed funding in 2013 through Andromède and Parrot and EUR12m Series A in 2016 through Andromède and Galia. The 2018 Intel Capital event remains separate; the Bpifrance loan is amount-undisclosed and held.

Company and investor announcements establish Corecam's December 2019 seed financing and March 2020 second closing plus separate 2021 investments by Expa, DRONE FUND and SYNERJET. Exact amounts remain undisclosed. ITOCHU was not duplicated because it is already linked to the 2022 Series A extension.

A company-specific GBP100,000 AeroSpace Cornwall match-funded grant was verified. Later UKRI announcements disclose consortium or programme totals, and Windracers' GBP30m cumulative funding-and-grants statement is not split into attributable events, so these remain holds.

The 2021 session.vc growth financing and 2023 Vista-led Series B are amount-undisclosed. A separate CHF2.5m Innosuisse accelerator grant announced on 4 May 2023 is verified and imported in original currency.
